title: 1976-09-15_Dorothy_168.txt
concise_summary: PKD reads his 27-year novel sequence — climaxing in 'Flow My Tears, the Policeman Said' — as a cumulative theological argument whose encoded message is that we live under Roman imperial tyranny (the Black Iron Prison) and that God, in the guise of Zebra, has returned to overthrow it. He develops a sophisticated theory of anamnesis: his fiction disinhibits blocked neural circuits in readers, waking them to the true nature of their enslavement. The entry pivots to a cosmological claim — that evil temporally defeated God roughly 2,000 years ago and banished him, making the intervening period an 'irreal' alibi; Zebra's recontouring of causal outcomes restores Pentecost to the present. Drawing on Burroughs' 'word virus' model and Robert Anton Wilson's Sirius hypothesis, PKD further proposes that an implanted symbiont called Firebright preserves his recovered immortality against re-infection by the enemy.
key_claims: PKD's entire 27-year fiction sequence constitutes a single encoded theological argument that reaches its resolution in 'Flow My Tears,' revealing that humanity lives under Roman imperial tyranny and that God is now intervening to overthrow it.

The 2,000 years between Pentecost and the present are not real historical time but an 'irreal' alibi manufactured by an evil entity that defeated and banished God; Zebra's ability to roll back time abolishes this gap and restores Pentecost to the present.

PKD's fiction operates neurologically to disinhibit GABA-blocked circuits in readers, inducing anamnesis — a waking-up to the true (enslaved) nature of their condition — in a way analogous to how Asimov and van Vogt set trains of thought in motion in PKD himself.

Evil won a decisive victory over God approximately 2,000 years ago and has ruled this world since; this answers Spinoza's theodicy problem, which Spinoza could not solve because he lacked knowledge of this prior defeat.

Zebra — identified with the cosmic Christ — is a healing organism that entered this world camouflaged to fight a 'criminal information virus' (Burroughs) that has infected the entire planet; its victory is manifest in the overthrow of the American government in 1974.

An entity called Firebright was surgically implanted in PKD during the 3-74 experiences to serve as a dormant internal guidance system protecting him from re-infection by enemy forces (Solarcon), preserving his recovered immortality.
recurring_concepts: Zebra — camouflaged divine healing organism that reconfigures causal outcomes and fights the criminal virus
Anamnesis — waking-up or recovered memory of one's true enslaved condition, induced by PKD's fiction
The Black Iron Prison (BIP) — the tyrannical imperial system (Rome/America) that rules the world and inflicts suffering on the innocent
Firebright — symbiotic implant placed in PKD during 3-74 as a dormant internal guidance and protection system
The word/information virus — Burroughs-derived concept of an alien criminal virus encoded in language that has enslaved humanity
GABA-blocked / inhibited neural circuits — neurological metaphor for the suppression of true spiritual perception that PKD's writing reverses
The irreal 2,000 years — linear time between Pentecost and now as a diabolical fabrication masking the true present
Rome as Platonic archetype — the eternal tyrannical imperial form that recurs across history, currently instantiated as America
people_entities: Spinoza, Baruch (17th-century philosopher) — cited for his claim that miracles would signal God's weakness; PKD refutes him on grounds Spinoza lacked knowledge of God's defeat by evil
Burroughs, William S. (20th-century novelist) — cited for 'The Ticket That Exploded' and his model of a criminal word-virus and nova police, which PKD maps onto Zebra and the enemy
Bob Wilson / Robert Anton Wilson (20th-century writer) — cited for connecting the ajna-eye entity with the star Sirius
Asimov, Isaac (20th-century SF writer) — cited as a precursor who treated the Roman Empire/Christianity theme in the Foundation novels and 'Pebble in the Sky'
van Vogt, A.E. (20th-century SF writer) — cited for 'Ptath,' which PKD reads as concealing a God behind fake memories
Kathy — a figure from a dream PKD had in Canada who announces the revelation of concealment ('Now you can know the point to all this concealment and acting')
Joan — identified in the nitrous oxide experiences as 'one of the enemy' / Solarcon
Thomas — PKD's alter ego / past-life apostolic Christian identity; the 'ur person' underlying PKD's present personality
Pinky — figure used in an analogy about transubstantiation / identity transference (Thomas:PKD :: Pinky:him)
Asklepios — Greek healing god, implicitly identified with the force that healed PKD in 3-74

Ubik (PKD novel) — cited as containing answers to the great dialectic; its cheap/vulgar mask imagery linked to the Light's disguise strategy

The Eye in the Sky (PKD novel, abbreviated 'Eye') — part of the essential sequence
Confessions of a Crap Artist (PKD novel, abbreviated 'Joint') — part of the sequence; contains temporal ambiguities similar to Tears
Martian Time-Slip (PKD novel, abbreviated 'time slip') — mentioned as possibly part of the sequence

Pebble in the Sky (Isaac Asimov novel) — cited as treating the Rome/Christianity archetype
Foundation series (Isaac Asimov) — cited as a precursor treating imperial archetype
Ptath (A.E. van Vogt novel) — cited for concealing a God behind fake memories
The Book of Acts (New Testament) — the spirit-filled world of Acts is argued to be our actual present location
The New Testament — its overall narrative read as the rejection and killing of the Light, with a promised return
autobiographical: The 3-74 experiences (February-March 1974) — PKD describes this as the period when he temporarily threw off the word virus and received the revelation about Christ's presence, but was subsequently re-infected

A dream had in Canada in which a figure named Kathy said 'Now you can know the point to all this concealment and acting' and everyone took off their masks — PKD identifies this as a precognitive experience now being fulfilled
Receiving a voice that said '...she was not acceptable before' — cited as a cryptic divine communication during the 3-74 experiences
Nitrous oxide experiences — PKD describes communications from Firebright during these sessions, including a warning about Joan being 'one of the enemy'
Receiving 'the xerox missive' — an anonymous threatening document sent by enemy forces (Solarcon), mentioned as an example of the danger Firebright is designed to detect
Surgical implantation of Firebright — PKD describes a healing entity (associated with Asklepios) having implanted a symbiotic guidance system within him during 3-74
The 27-year writing sequence — PKD frames his entire career from approximately 1947-1974 as an unconscious working-out of a single theological question that resolved in Tears
theological_motifs: Pentecost — the descent of the Holy Spirit on the twelve apostles; PKD argues Zebra restores this moment to the present by making the intervening 2,000 years irreal
Agape — divine love as the political and spiritual program called for by Tears: revolution first, then reconciliation with the enemy
Transubstantiation — invoked analogically: as Christ is transubstantiated into Pinky, Thomas (apostolic Christian) is transubstantiated into PKD
Theodicy — the problem of evil reframed: God permits evil because evil temporarily defeated and banished him; God is not omnipotent in the present world
The Passion of Christ — read as the paradigmatic pattern of the Light being killed and rejected, recurring whenever any person or animal is humiliated and killed
Anamnesis — Platonic/Gnostic recollection of one's true nature; PKD's fiction as an instrument for inducing it in readers
The covert Fish / underground church — the secret Xtian community hiding from the police establishment, analogous to early Christians under Rome
Gnostic cosmology — evil has seized control of this world; the true God must sneak in camouflaged; Christ came to abolish suffering, not join it
The ajna eye — third eye / pineal perception associated with the entity that watched and then entered PKD; Bob Wilson links this to Sirius
Sacred time vs. linear time — archetypes are permanent; linear historical time is reduced to a 'zero factor'; past and future collapse into a single continuum
literary_self_ref: PKD argues that 'Flow My Tears' is the resolution of a 27-year dialectical sequence running through his entire oeuvre, with MITHC, Eye in the Sky, Confessions of a Crap Artist, Martian Time-Slip, Ubik, A Maze of Death, and The Three Stigmata as necessary preparatory steps
He claims 'Flow My Tears,' when decoded, calls for a specific political-theological program: God-led revolution by prisoners followed by agape and reconciliation with the enemy
PKD wonders whether his fiction induces anamnesis in readers the way Asimov and van Vogt induced trains of thought in him — framing his writing as a neurological / spiritual technology
He identifies the GABA-blocked neural circuit theory as applicable to his own writing process: either Tears stemmed from disinhibited circuits in his mind, or Tears itself disinhibited those circuits
Ubik's cheap/vulgar mask imagery is directly linked to the Light's strategy of entering history through despised and lowly forms to evade detection by solemn evil powers
A Scanner Darkly is cited as formally enacting the theological principle that time is nonexistent — a 'novel about the past set in the future' — making its structure a theological statement

PKD states that 'in a certain real sense we are actually in Rome c. AD 70' and notes that 'the evil entity and counterfeit world are connected in my writing,' linking his fictional themes directly to his ontological claims
symbols_images: Wind blowing through dry weeds, tracing a path — image of the divine as invisible, silent, like electricity moving through dead matter
The sacred void / the abyss — associated with the path traced by wind through weeds; a figure for divine presence in apparent emptiness
'The answer is blowing in the wind' — citation of Bob Dylan lyric as unwitting theological truth
The mask — everyone in the Canada dream removes their masks to reveal the truth underneath; concealment as the structure of this world
The beggar — Christ returned to the world in disguise, entering through 'trash routes' and despised forms to avoid detection
The cheap and vulgar mask of Ubik thrown off — the moment of revelation when the Light's lowly disguise is discarded to show its true nature
Firebright — named symbiotic entity implanted in PKD, described as possibly a microcomputer or computerized guidance system living dormant within him
The xerox missive — threatening anonymous document sent by Solarcon / enemy forces, example of the danger Firebright monitors
Surgical implantation — medical metaphor for how healing forces inserted Firebright into PKD, associated with Asklepios
The 50/50 juxtaposition — Burroughs' image of two realities superimposed, which PKD saw during 3-74
tensions: PKD claims his fiction induces anamnesis in readers, but then hedges: 'my stories + novels don't contain the whole message, + alone they can't induce anamnesis' — partially retracting the claim within the same entry

He shifts between two framings of the 3-74 experience: (1) he threw off the word virus himself, and (2) it was done for him (probably the latter, cf. Asklepios) — the question of agency remains unresolved
PKD describes Firebright as 'alive but dormant within me' while simultaneously wondering if it is 'a microcomputer' — oscillating between a living symbiont and a mechanical guidance device
He identifies the enemy as 'Solarcon' and says 'I don't understand them' — naming the enemy while admitting total ignorance of their nature, leaving the threat undefined

The claim that PKD was 're-infected' and 'again blinded' after 3-74 implies that his current writing state may itself be compromised — yet the entry proceeds as confident theological exegesis, without acknowledging this as a problem for his own reliability

PKD's refutation of Spinoza (miracles are not signs of God's weakness) relies on the secret of God's defeat — but this 'secret' was itself received through visionary experience whose accuracy PKD cannot independently verify

The Soviet question is raised ('Have we recently been invaded? Or a long time ago?') then immediately dropped — suggesting PKD entertained a geopolitical rather than cosmic explanation for his personality changes but did not pursue it
evidence_quotes: What Good does it do to kill everyone who has melded with the spirit if Zebra can roll back time to the period of "Acts" before the true, spirit-filled Christians were killed? Perhaps it can be counted a miracle of God rather than a defect in creative power by Yin that the intervening 2000 years are [made] irreal, since, if they are irreal, Pentecost is restored to the present and nothing is lost.

Spinoza was not in possession of the secret that evil had won, a long time ago, + ousted God from this world. What an extraordinary theological thought-answer to the Q.: ["if God exists, why can't we see him + why does he permit evil?" Fact is, evil did him in - temporarily - + banished him.

The true deity has reasserted itself in the overthrowing of the American government. Perhaps one of the reasons for its victory is that the evil powers did not understand what they were up against, sincerely believing that they had destroyed -not just banished- the Light. Especially since the Light re-entered by "trash" routes.

I know little about the enemy; but the sentient power which took complete control of me is connected with the cosmic Christ, a healer + wise entity. Equal to Burroughs' nova police. Certainly it seems benign to me. It saved me, + it was here in pursuit of "the conspirators" to do them in. It had been watching: it told me that - watching with the ajna eye. Bob Wilson connects this with the star Sirius.
It is a typical evil lie about "joining Christ" on the way to the cross in suffering; he came here to abolish it.
uncertainty_flags: PKD refers to 'Pinky' in an analogy about transubstantiation — the referent is unclear; it may be a character from one of his own novels or a personal acquaintance, and no context is provided in this segment
The figure 'Kathy' from the Canada dream is not identified; it is unclear whether this is a real person PKD knew or a purely dream figure

PKD mentions 'Joan' as 'one of the enemy' identified during nitrous oxide sessions — her full identity is not given; this could refer to a real person in his life but is unverifiable from this text alone
'Solarcon' is named as the enemy organization but never explained — it is unclear whether this is a term PKD coined, a reference to a real organization he suspected, or a symbolic label
The 'xerox missive' is cited as a concrete example of enemy action, but no details are given; the nature of this document and who sent it is unresolved

PKD raises the possibility that Zebra / the controlling entity might be Soviet in origin ('Have we recently been invaded?'), which conflicts with his dominant identification of Zebra as the cosmic Christ — no resolution is offered
The reference to 'Asperin of Mercury Albemuth' is garbled (likely 'Arsphenamine' or a similar alchemical/medical term), making the precise meaning of this healing image unclear

PKD's identification of the 1974 Watergate-era fall of the Nixon administration as 'the overthrowing of the American government' by divine action conflates a political event with eschatological intervention — the evidential basis for this identification is purely visionary
